counting_policy: Candidate labels are not a comprehensive source corpus; unknown never counts as covered, partial, missing, or not-applicable for denominator reporting.

candidates.label: Trust Task
candidates.rationale: TIG defines the inherited ToIP Layer-3 task/protocol meaning, while DTGWG Trust Tasks describes a self-contained, transport-agnostic JSON outcome document; material semantic mismatch requiring adjudication, not an exact mapping.

candidates.label: trust registry
candidates.rationale: Existing concept discovered; cross-domain meaning requires review.

candidates.label: Verifiable Trust Agent
candidates.rationale: Expected filename did not resolve; this does not demonstrate concept absence.

candidates.label: Verifiable Trust Community
candidates.rationale: Expected filename did not resolve; alternate designations and concepts still need searching.
